subject: Compact two-day loop: handoff grid + staggered slots (candidate: Jordan Ellis)
messages:
-----Original Message-----
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.com>, Jordan Ellis <jordan.ellis@gmail.com>
Date: Tue, 1 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Compact two-day loop: handoff grid + staggered slots (candidate: Jordan Ellis)

Team —

We need to finalize the virtual onsite for Jordan Ellis (SWE II). Rather than a full-day block, I propose a compact two-day loop with staggered panels to reduce video fatigue and allow quick debrief handoffs. High-level proposal below: please reply with "OK" or suggest alternatives by EOD Thu.

Day A (Mon 13 Dec)
- 09:30–10:10: Phone screen + culture (Talently/Recruiter) — not on this thread
- 11:00–11:50: Systems design (Jonas)
- 13:00–13:40: Backend deep-dive (Laura)
- 15:00–15:30: Short behavioral sync / buffer (Marissa)

Day B (Tue 14 Dec)
- 10:00–10:40: Full-stack / API design (Laura)
- 12:20–13:00: Code exercise walkthrough (Marissa)
- 14:30–15:00: Leadership / hiring manager debrief (Sofia)

Key points:
- 30–40 minute interviews where possible; 20–30 minute buffers between related panels for quick debriefs and evaluator handoffs.
- I attached the first-pass panel grid and Jordan's CV.
- Please confirm evaluator ownership and indicate any slot you cannot make. If you need a swap, propose a backup.

Attachments: Panel_Grid_v2.pdf, Jordan_Ellis_CV.pdf

Thanks,
Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Talent Partner, Redwood Inference
-----

>
> Two small asks:
> - Can we flip the Mon afternoon buffer to 14:00 instead of 15:00? That gives a better handoff from backend to behavior.
> - I updated the panel grid (attached) and included a suggested rubric column for security/scale questions.
>
> Attaching: Panel_Grid_v2a.pdf (minor edits), see note on rubric.
>
> Laura
